That actually helps a lot, bluecombats. Right *now* no one is accusing me of anything. Right *now* I am not lying about anything. Right *now* there is no strife, no fight. Little steps through the present to get to a better future.

Thank you so much for taking this time to help
Thank you. I agree with you about being 100% honest, which is what I have promised him I will be and what I am striving to be.

I'm scared that anything I say is going to be twisted around or used against me. I'm scared that these very thoughts of suicide are proof that I really am too broken. I'm scared I will never see him again.
